summary: Wordle entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Wordle

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.version: Current New York Times Wordle web version
primary.why: Wordle is a daily web puzzle now operated by The New York Times. The browser version is the cleanest primary route, while the NYT Games mobile app is a convenient secondary access route to the same daily puzzle ecosystem.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Wordle at the New York Times Games site in a desktop browser. Record the puzzle number/date and avoid archive spoilers in notes unless needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original Wardle-hosted version is historical; NYT-era puzzle list and account/stat features can differ. Record the puzzle date/number.
